description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointing the members of the Wages Board for the Janitorial Service Trade for a Period of 03 Years Commencing on 02.12.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointment of members to a Wages Board under the Wages Boards Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It involves the establishment of a statutory body and the exercise of powers granted by specific legislation (Wages Boards Ordinance Chapter 136), making it a legal/regulatory action rather than a core government personnel or structural change.
